column1: # Level-up stat-upgrade cards (data-driven menu; read by LevelUpDatabase).
#   key    - selects the effect in Player::ApplyStatUpgrade (must match a case)
#            "+{a} Speed" or "+{p} Damage"). The number is filled from `amount`
#   weight - relative roll odds (percent options use 1
#   amount - effect magnitude; meaning depends on key:
#            *_pct / *_chance / gold_gain / xp_gain / tower_* % use a fraction
#            (0.15 = +15%); *_flat / crit_damage / tower_hp use a raw value.
